subject: contract-dioxus-dom-bridge
contract-dioxus-dom-bridge
text: - `is_masked_input(&ElementData) -> bool`, public and re-exported beside `MASKED_VALUE`: true for an `input` whose `type` reads `password` or `file`, ASCII case-insensitive — the test the snapshot's `value` reader calls, no reading changed, and the one escher-driver's recorder reads to keep a masked `type` as its stand-in (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:233-240).

subject: contract-dioxus-dom-bridge
text: - A select in the bridge and the snapshot: `Input | Change` reach the app as `NativeFormData { value }`, so an `onchange` handler fires (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/dioxus_document.rs:393-398); the snapshot's `value` reader takes the document and the node and reads a `select` through `BaseDocument::select_value`, no mask applying (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:256-261); and an option whose parent is a `select` reads its select's client rect as its `bounds` (the private `select_parent`), so a select's options are its children in the snapshot, named by their labels (packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:144-153; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/snapshot.rs:241-250).

subject: contract-clis
contract-clis
text: - `multi_doc`, a root example: a mode and an iteration count from its arguments (examples/multi_doc.rs:48-54), its document count, layout and threading from `MULTI_DOC_N` · `MULTI_DOC_FLAT` · `MULTI_DOC_SEQ` (§Occupied Resources → Environment variables); it times each resolve with `Instant::now()` (examples/multi_doc.rs:61-67), prints one summary line on stdout (examples/multi_doc.rs:111-115) and panics on an unknown mode (examples/multi_doc.rs:108).

subject: contract-browser-app
text: - **Browser app:** `HistoryEntry` id, url, title, favicon_url, visited_at (apps/browser/persistence/src/lib.rs:56-63); `HistoryStore` `open`, `load_recent`, `record_visit`, `clear`, `set_favicon_by_url` (apps/browser/persistence/src/lib.rs:103-148); `history_entries` table id INTEGER PK AUTOINCREMENT, url TEXT NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL, favicon_url TEXT, visited_at INTEGER NOT NULL, indexes on visited_at DESC and url (apps/browser/persistence/src/lib.rs:39-49); `BrowserNavProvider::navigate_to` pushes tab history (apps/browser/src/history.rs:101-109); rdme `ReadmeNavigationProvider` forwards `BlitzShellEvent::Navigate` (apps/readme/src/main.rs:64-73) and handles `ReadmeEvent`, `Navigate`, `NavigationLoad` (apps/readme/src/readme_application.rs:190-215); `LoadedDocument` (apps/browser/src/document_loader.rs:21-34); `make_doc_config` (apps/browser/src/document_loader.rs:45-65); about URLs `about:newtab`, `about:settings`, `about:history`, `about:bookmarks` (apps/browser/src/about_pages.rs:51-58); View Source writes `view-source://` plus the URL (apps/browser/src/toolbar.rs:183-213); `UrlSuggester` context with `suggestions()` and `set_query()` (apps/browser/src/url_suggestions.rs:54-68; apps/browser/src/url_suggestions.rs:206-228)

subject: contract-wpt-runner-outputs
text:
- **WPT runner outputs:** output directory `output` under the parent of `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR`, recreated each run (wpt/runner/src/main.rs:494-499); `wpt_expectations.txt` one line per test with per-subtest chars `Y`/`N`/`T`/`.` (wpt/runner/src/report.rs:123-147; wpt/runner/src/main.rs:834-837); `wptreport.json` `WptReport` (wpt/runner/src/report.rs:78-121; wpt/runner/src/main.rs:839-849) with run_info product `blitz`, revisions from git HEAD, automation and headless true (wpt/runner/src/report.rs:26-56); reftest images `{test}-test.png`, `{test}-ref{suffix}.png`, `{test}-diff{suffix}.png` (wpt/runner/src/test_runners/ref_test.rs:34-36; wpt/runner/src/test_runners/ref_test.rs:167-175; wpt/runner/src/test_runners/ref_test.rs:207-210); page messages `wpt_results` and `unsupported_feature` via `__blitz_send_message` (wpt/runner/src/test_runners/harness_test.rs:35-49; wpt/runner/src/test_runners/harness_test.rs:69-73; wpt/runner/src/test_runners/harness_test.rs:231-240); harness codes 0 OK, 1 ERROR, 2 TIMEOUT, 3 PRECONDITION_FAILED and subtest codes 0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 2 TIMEOUT, 3 NOTRUN, 4 PRECONDITION_FAILED (wpt/runner/src/test_runners/harness_test.rs:185-188; wpt/runner/src/test_runners/harness_test.rs:261-269); `WptScriptFetcher` custom `/resources/testharnessreport.js` and `/resources/testdriver-vendor.js`, `WebIDLParser.js` rewrite (wpt/runner/src/test_runners/harness_test.rs:83-112); native checkLayout attributes (wpt/runner/src/test_runners/attr_test.rs:163-223); `<meta name=fuzzy>` grammar (wpt/runner/src/test_runners/fuzzy.rs:1-7), per-reference spec winning (wpt/runner/src/test_runners/fuzzy.rs:99-110); result line `STATUS (pass/total) name (Nms) KIND` plus flags (wpt/runner/src/main.rs:368-445); kinds REF, ATT, CRA, HAR, UNK and statuses PASS, FAIL, TIMEOUT, SKIP, CRASH (wpt/runner/src/main.rs:97-106; wpt/runner/src/main.rs:118-127);
 flag letters F, I, C, D, W, S, M, X (wpt/runner/src/main.rs:74-86; wpt/runner/src/main.rs:416-439); subtest counts to status (wpt/runner/src/main.rs:152-160); `WptNetProvider` decodes `data:` and resolves other paths against the WPT base on disk (wpt/runner/src/net_provider.rs:57-95); documents use a base URL under `http://dummy.local`, `DummyNavigationProvider` and `HtmlProvider` (wpt/runner/src/test_runners/mod.rs:355-364; wpt/runner/src/main.rs:581-582)
